picks.title: Superhuman acquires AI detection startup GPTZero
picks.why_it_matters: Signals consolidation in the AI tooling space and validates AI detection as a feature play rather than standalone company—a cautionary data point for founders building single-feature AI products.

picks.title: Fika Jobs raises $4M to build a video-first hiring platform where AI agents interview candidates
picks.why_it_matters: Early-stage deal showing continued investor appetite for AI agents tackling specific workflow verticals, with HR tech being ripe for automation disruption.

picks.title: HaloBraid raises $7M from Seven Seven Six to end the six-hour hair salon appointment
picks.why_it_matters: Alexis Ohanian's fund backing hardware-enabled services for underserved markets highlights opportunity in verticalized robotics and tools targeting overlooked consumer segments.
